common.keepOpen: Keep the app open until this finishes.

error.picker: Couldn’t open the file picker. Try again.
error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the VPS over SSH. Check the login, then try again.

update.title: Update {{name}}

description.login: Sign in over SSH to check this server’s version.
description.configured: Check for a signed release and review it before installing.
description.setup: Updates aren’t set up for this server yet.

update.statusUnknown: Couldn’t read the installed version. Setup can still install verified server software.

warning.mismatch: Installed server software doesn’t match its signed record. Repair the server before updating.
warning.automaticFailed: The last automatic security update failed. Check the release source, then check for updates.

recovery.needed: An interrupted update needs recovery first.

source.label: Release source
source.help: An HTTPS address ending in /, from whoever installed this server
source.invalid: Use an HTTPS address that ends in / and has no user name, ? or #.

channel.label: Release channel
channel.previewHint: Early builds that may be less stable. Use them only to try new features.

review.label: Verified release
review.title: Release {{version}}
review.baseline: Installs this release and keeps the server’s identity and access. Services restart briefly.
review.register: Matches the installed software. Finish setup to register it for updates.
review.upgrade: Services restart briefly. If the health check fails, the previous version is restored.
review.incompatible: Can’t be installed in the server’s current state

schedule.help: Checked daily from the release source above. Signature and rollback checks still apply.

rollback.title: Previous version
rollback.kept: Version {{version}} is kept so you can roll back if this one misbehaves.
rollback.confirmMessage: Services restart and devices reconnect briefly. This works only if that version is still trusted and compatible.

privacy.identifiers: Requests carry no device, server, or user identifiers.
privacy.signing: Only releases signed by keys built into SirinVPN are accepted, whatever the source.

update.disconnectFirst: Disconnect this device to install, recover or roll back.

done.setUp: Updates are set up. Version {{version}} is installed.

error.notVerified: Verify the server’s SSH key first.
error.status: Couldn’t read the server’s update status.
error.check: Couldn’t verify this release. Check the source and channel.
error.notConfirmed: The server didn’t confirm the new version. Check its status before trying again.
error.stopped: The operation stopped. Check the server’s status before trying again.
error.scheduleNotConfirmed: The server didn’t confirm the new schedule. Check its settings before trying again.

blocked.mismatch: Repair the VPS before checking for or installing updates.
blocked.source: Enter a release source to check.

backup.title: Back up {{name}}
backup.description: Save the server’s identity and settings to restore or move it later.
backup.warning: Anyone with this file and its password can clone the server. Store them separately.
backup.doneNote: Store the file and its password separately.

missing.file: Choose where to save the backup.
missing.password: Enter a backup password of at least 12 characters.

schedule.title: Scheduled VPS backups
schedule.description: An encrypted backup is saved on a schedule. The newest ones stay in a folder you choose.
schedule.folderHint: Older backups beyond the limit are deleted from this folder.
schedule.folderDialogTitle: Choose a folder for VPS backups
schedule.passwordHint: Use at least 12 characters. It’s saved in this device’s secure storage.
schedule.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved password
schedule.loginMissing: Backups use this VPS’s saved SSH login. Back up the VPS once with Remember login on.
schedule.disconnected: Backups run while SirinVPN is open and this device is disconnected.
schedule.stale: Backups are overdue. Disconnect this device while SirinVPN is open, or choose Back up now.

notice.failed: The last scheduled VPS backup didn’t finish.

restore.title: Restore {{name}}
restore.description: Restore this server’s identity onto the same or a new VPS.
restore.warning: An old backup can bring back access you’ve since revoked. Review members and devices afterward.
restore.hostHint: Keep the current address to recover, or enter a new one to move the server.
restore.replaceHint: Use if SirinVPN is already on that VPS. Other services aren’t touched.
restore.doneNote: This device now uses {{host}}. If the address changed, move your other devices before shutting down the old VPS.
restore.error: Restore stopped. The VPS returns to its previous state and this device is unchanged.

missing.password: Enter the backup’s password (at least 12 characters).
missing.host: Enter the VPS address as a hostname or IP address.

consequence.replace: The SirinVPN install on this VPS is replaced by the one in the backup.
consequence.install: SirinVPN is installed on this VPS from the backup.
consequence.access: Members and devices you removed after this backup was made get access again.
consequence.device: This device switches to {{host}}. Services restart briefly.

repair.title: Repair {{name}}

description.repair: Reinstall server software without changing identities or access.
description.dns: Anything you don’t change stays as it is.

repair.note: The VPN is briefly unavailable while the server restarts.

error.repair: Repair stopped. Identities are unchanged and partial changes roll back automatically.
error.dns: DNS changes stopped. Partial changes roll back automatically.

repair.optionsNote: Addresses, ports, DNS and NAT64 stay as they are unless you change them here.
repair.progressDns: Applying DNS settings and checking the server…

summary.title: {{name}} is ready to reconnect
summary.identities: Server and device identities, and access
summary.fingerprintSaved: Pinned in this device’s server profile
summary.networkNote: Firewall access wasn’t checked. Review these if connecting fails.
summary.next: Connect from Home to test this device’s connection.

description.owner: Remove it from this device, or uninstall SirinVPN from the VPS.
description.member: Only the Owner can uninstall SirinVPN from the VPS.

local.title: Remove from this device
local.summary: Deletes its key here; the server stays installed
local.confirmOwner: Its Owner key on this device is deleted. The server stays installed and claimed.
local.confirmMember: This device’s key is deleted. The server isn’t changed.
local.error: Couldn’t remove the server from this device.

uninstall.title: Uninstall from VPS
uninstall.summary: Removes SirinVPN from the VPS, then from this device
uninstall.confirmMessage: All devices and invitations for this server stop working. Docker and other services on the VPS are kept.
uninstall.error: Uninstall didn’t finish. The VPS rolls back partial changes and this device keeps the server.

endpoint.description: Signed updates move devices to the server’s new address and settings.
endpoint.pending: Devices still using {{host}} need this update before you retire that VPS.
endpoint.intro: The new VPS signs the update. Then publish it on the old VPS for your devices.
endpoint.connectFirst: Connect to the new VPS first.
endpoint.codeHint: Contains no access keys; its signature prevents tampering
endpoint.publishNote: Devices still connecting to the old VPS get the update there.
endpoint.appliedNote: Check that the connection works at the new address.
endpoint.applyIntro: Paste the code from the server’s Owner, or get it from the server.
endpoint.identityNote: The new address must still prove the same server identity.

error.create: Couldn’t create the update. Keep the old VPS running and try again while connected.
error.retrieve: Couldn’t get an address update from this server.
error.publish: Couldn’t publish on the old VPS. It’s unchanged, so you can try again.
error.apply: Couldn’t apply the update. Check your connection.

endpoint.pasteFirst: Paste a code to verify it.
endpoint.none: This server has no address update waiting.

alerts.title: VPS alerts
alerts.summary: Get a notification when this VPS needs attention, and let an outside monitor notice when it goes silent. Off until you add an address. Notices carry fixed text only: no names, addresses or traffic.
alerts.unsupported: Repair this server with the current app to use VPS alerts.

ntfy.label: ntfy topic
ntfy.hint: Plain text with a title, for an ntfy server you choose

webhook.label: Webhook
webhook.hint: A small JSON object with a title, message and text

alerts.alertUrlHint: Optional. The full HTTPS address of your topic or webhook. The VPS checks every five minutes and sends when a problem starts or clears.
alerts.heartbeatHint: Optional. The VPS requests it every five minutes. Point it at a missed-heartbeat monitor to learn when the VPS is down or offline.
alerts.invalid: Use a full HTTPS address without a user name.
alerts.allowPrivate: Allow private, loopback and VPN addresses
alerts.saved: Saved. The VPS uses it at its next check.
alerts.testSent: The VPS delivered a test alert.
alerts.testFailed: The test alert couldn’t be sent.

status.notChecked: The VPS hasn’t checked yet. It checks every five minutes.
status.alertFailed: The last alert wasn’t delivered. {{reason}} The VPS tries again at its next check.

failure.address: The address didn’t resolve, or it resolved to a private address that isn’t allowed.
failure.connection: The VPS couldn’t reach the address over HTTPS.
failure.rejectedStatus: The address answered with HTTP status {{status}}.

rotation.confirmFirst: Tick the box above to continue.
rotation.unchanged: Nothing changed. Your current keys still work.
rotation.interrupted: The rotation was interrupted. Resume it to finish; until then this device can’t connect.

deviceBackup.confirmFirst: Tick the box above to confirm.
